requirement_text.REQ-064: Execute Decision 0006's D2 (docs/migration/decisions/0006-identity-tables-schema-per-tenant.md): drop tenant_id from ten schema-isolated business tables. Full acceptance criteria list is in docs/requirements.yaml's REQ-064 entry -- read it there directly.

task.description:
Independently re-run mix test yourself -- do not trust TEST-RUNNER's report alone. Then confirm every one of REQ-064's seven acceptance criteria (read them directly from docs/requirements.yaml, not from any prior handoff's paraphrase) is satisfied against the actual shipped code/tests.

This run's own history is worth being aware of, not repeating: the test-design gate FAILed once and required one rework cycle -- a test restructure had silently dropped the only assertion covering TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1's own contract, caught because REQ-064's acceptance criteria explicitly required that function stay tested. The fix added a direct unit test to test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs. Confirm that test still exists and still passes as part of your own independent check -- don't assume the earlier gate's finding is still true just because it passed once.

Also this run's security gate (HIGH priority) traced three implementation fixes beyond the original design's scope for cross-tenant safety -- all PASSed. As RELEASE-VALIDATOR your job isn't to re-do that security trace, but do confirm via docs/requirements.yaml and git log that this diff's scope genuinely matches what REQ-064 asked for (D2 only -- the ten-table tenant_id drop -- not touching the four D3 tables or reopening D1's schema-per-tenant isolation choice).

Check docs/requirements.yaml (REQ-064's own status field, currently in_progress) and docs/status/requirement_status.yaml for staleness relative to what actually shipped.

Check whether decision 0006 (docs/migration/decisions/0006-identity-tables-schema-per-tenant.md) needs any update now that BOTH D1 (REQ-063) and D2 (REQ-064) have shipped -- its Status line was updated during REQ-063's own release validation to say 'D1 shipped... D2 not yet executed -- pending REQ-064.' That D2-pending wording is now stale.
